neighbours.label: the modifier in the slot immediately before a nominalization like formation, construct, construction or invention (rock formations, social construct, Hollywood invention): the pole predicts that nominalization
fire: Erosion has left a series of strange sandstone formations along the ridge.
Many historians treat the nation as a modern political construct.
The notion of the self-made man is partly a literary invention.
Divers photographed the coral formations on the outer reef.
Childhood, some argue, is a cultural construction rather than a fact of nature.
The legend of the lone sheriff is largely a cinematic invention.
Wind has carved tall limestone formations above the dry riverbed.
Gender roles here are treated as a social construction, not a given.
quiet: Sandstone blocks were quarried along the ridge for the cathedral.
Many historians treat the nation as a political actor in its own right.
The notion of the self-made man appears in literary fiction of the period.
Divers photographed the coral reef on a calm morning.
Childhood, some argue, is shaped by cultural habits learned at home.
The legend of the lone sheriff was filmed in cinematic black and white.
Wind has carved tall limestone cliffs above the dry riverbed.
Gender roles here are treated as a social matter, not a legal one.

predictions: Fires on the premodifier when the next word is formation(s), construct(ion) or invention; the same modifier before any other noun stays low.
notes: The + pole suppresses ' formation', ' creation', ' construction', ' construct', ' installation', which identifies this as a left-context predictor of that nominalization. Probe: 'social construct' 0.708, 'rock formations' 0.657, 'Hollywood invention' 0.626, 'bedrock reservoir' 0.573; the same words elsewhere, 'rock music festival' 0.197, 'social media' 0.003, 'studio in Hollywood' 0.002, and 'unique phenomenon' 0.112.
